entries.name: Acid Pools
entries.effect: Corrosive steaming pools eat through boots and gear.
entries.guidance: Navigate single-file with caution or suffer gear degradation.

entries.name: Allergenic & Poisonous Plants
entries.effect: Pungent pollen causes burning eyes, coughing fits, and rash.
entries.guidance: Cover face with dampened cloth or suffer -1 on checks.

entries.name: Ancient Dormant Sickness
entries.effect: Plague-bearing mist or mold in old hollows.
entries.guidance: Test constitution or contract shivering ague.

entries.name: Lurking Curse
entries.effect: An invisible hex clings to trespassers.
entries.guidance: Spurs misfortune on the next critical encounter.

entries.name: Treacherous Footing
entries.effect: Slippery shale, boggy moss, or loose scree slows progress to a crawl.
entries.guidance: Travel takes double time or risk sprained ankles.

entries.name: Disorienting Terrain
entries.effect: Confusing ridgelines or identical copses make it easy to get lost.
entries.guidance: Navigation check required or lose half a day doubling back.

entries.name: Blinding Fog
entries.effect: Dense white pea-soup mist blankets the entire hex.
entries.guidance: Visibility reduced to 10 paces; surprise checks are at disadvantage.

entries.name: Noxious Fumes
entries.effect: Volcanic sulfur or decaying peat gas chokes the lungs.
entries.guidance: Hasten through the area or suffer fatigue.

entries.name: Restless Hauntings
entries.effect: Spirits of massacred wanderers follow with chilling wails.
entries.guidance: Interrupts restful sleep; camping here grants no recovery.

entries.name: Hallucinogenic Spores
entries.effect: Puffball mushrooms burst into vibrant psychedelic clouds.
entries.guidance: Visions, disorientation, and paranoia plague the party.

entries.name: Concealed Natural Pits
entries.effect: Deep fissures overgrown with brambles and vines.
entries.guidance: Front scout must test alertness to avoid tumbling 20 feet.

entries.name: Old Hunting Traps
entries.effect: Rusted iron wolf traps and deadfalls set by poachers.
entries.guidance: Careful search required to avoid severe leg wound.

entries.name: Eldritch Taint
entries.effect: Warped mutations, violet grass, and reversed shadows.
entries.guidance: Prolonged exposure risks strange cosmetic or behavioral afflictions.

entries.name: Outbreak / Contaminated Water
entries.effect: The streams and ponds are tainted with rotting carcasses.
entries.guidance: Drinking unboiled water causes debilitating cramps.

entries.name: Quicksand / Mud Sink
entries.effect: Firm-looking ground gives way into a sucking mire.
entries.guidance: Requires rope and teamwork to extract trapped pack beasts.

entries.name: Arcane Radiation
entries.effect: Faint blue hum warms metal armor and sickens creatures.
entries.guidance: Iron grows hot to the touch; spellcasting causes unpredictable surges.

entries.name: Sabotaged Trail
entries.effect: Felled timber and booby-trapped ropes placed by bandits.
entries.guidance: Ambush is likely if the trap is triggered.

entries.name: Unstable Cliff / Overhang
entries.effect: Cracking rock ledges liable to shear off under pack weight.
entries.guidance: Tether party members together while traversing heights.

entries.name: Venomous Swarm
entries.effect: Nests of red hornets, vipers, or black scorpions.
entries.guidance: Scout ahead with smoke or detour around nesting grounds.

entries.name: Active Thermal Vent
entries.effect: Superheated geysers and spurts of scalding mud.
entries.guidance: Listen for rumbling ground to avoid scalding eruptions.
